svg.title: Live dissection: unmask vs a fake FPS booster
svg.desc: unmask traces FpsBooster_v2.1.zip, a fake FPS booster, without running it: ZIP, .NET bait assembly, resources, icon_data XOR with a recovered 12-byte key, njRAT 0.7d. Decrypted config: C2 kira-lab-c2[.]ddns[.]net:5552; Victim tag HacKed; Mutex q8R2vT6yN4kP1mXw; Installs as %AppData%\Windows Update.exe; Persistence Run key · Startup copy; BSOD on kill yes; Telegram bot not used; Provider No-IP · dynamic DNS. Reported to No-IP abuse.
